mechanism: Event-exhaustive sum of YES prices must equal 1 for any complete set of outcome markets for the same event.
counterparty: Traders who price individual outcomes inconsistently, leaving the sum of YES prices across all outcomes of an event different from 1.
why_not_arbitraged: Liquidity fragmentation, event grouping not recognized by market participants, or fees/slippage prevent immediate arbitrage.
falsification: If on the sealed holdout, no event with multiple outcome markets has a sum of YES prices outside [1-epsilon, 1+epsilon] for epsilon greater than transaction costs, then the relation yields no trades.
target_market: Any event that has multiple outcome markets with mutually exclusive and exhaustive outcomes (e.g., a tournament winner market with one market per candidate).

relations.note: For any event that has multiple outcome markets that are mutually exclusive and exhaustive (e.g., 'Who will win X?' with one YES/NO market per candidate), the sum of YES prices across all outcome markets must be approximately 1. If sum < 1, buy YES in all outcomes; if sum > 1, sell YES in all outcomes (or buy NO in all).
